title: Full Code Parser
statement: For a code format and a Boolean list $x$, first decode a pair consisting of a bit list and a remainder, and interpret the bit list as a natural number $n$. Continue only if the bit list is exactly the binary representation of $n$ and the remainder has length at least the format's guard times $n+1$; then read an initial state among $n+1$ states and a transition table for $n$. Return the assembled code and the final remainder if every bit of that remainder is true; otherwise return no result.
hypotheses_covered: decoded bits equal the binary representation of their interpreted natural number
remainder length is at least guard times $n+1$
every bit in the final remainder is true
caveat: The pair decoder, natural-number interpretation, state reader, and table reader are not defined in the supplied context, so their precise encoding conventions cannot be specified.
